boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten documented no-admission places for a low-key art, architecture, or waterfront outing from UIC.

cards.title: See contemporary art at Gallery 400
cards.subtitle: 400 S. Peoria St. • UIC East Campus
cards.notes: Drop in during posted gallery hours, take in the current exhibition, and use the exhibition texts to start a shared conversation.
cards.short_summary: UIC’s contemporary-art gallery is free and open to all.
cards.evidence_claim: Gallery 400 states that it is free and open to all, with public hours Tuesday–Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Check Gallery 400’s current exhibition and hours before going; its site states it is free and open to all.

cards.title: Browse the National Museum of Mexican Art
cards.subtitle: 1852 W. 19th St. • Pilsen
cards.notes: Plan a self-guided gallery walk, then use the museum’s Pilsen mural guide to continue the conversation outdoors nearby.
cards.short_summary: A Pilsen art museum with always-free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Museum of Mexican Art states that admission is always free.
cards.source_title: Plan your visit | National Museum of Mexican Art
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday; the museum lists regular hours as 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and says admission is always free.

cards.title: Look up beneath the Chicago Cultural Center domes
cards.subtitle: 78 E. Washington St. • Loop
cards.notes: Meet inside, admire the two stained-glass domes, and check the day’s exhibitions or public-program listings before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A landmark civic arts building with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Choose Chicago lists Chicago Cultural Center admission as free and describes free public events and exhibitions.
cards.access_notes: Listed open daily 10 a.m.–5 p.m.; exhibitions close 15 minutes before the building closes, with holiday closures.

cards.title: Walk the Lincoln Park Conservatory rooms
cards.subtitle: 2391 N. Stockton Dr. • Lincoln Park
cards.notes: Reserve timed entry, then make a slow circuit through the Palm House, Fern Room, Orchid House, and seasonal Show House.
cards.short_summary: A free historic conservatory with four indoor display houses.
cards.evidence_claim: Chicago Park District states that admission to Lincoln Park Conservatory is free.
cards.source_title: Lincoln Park Conservatory | Chicago Park District
cards.access_notes: Timed entry is required. The Park District lists Wednesday–Sunday hours of 10 a.m.–5 p.m., with Monday and Tuesday closures.

cards.title: Take a lakefront walk at Navy Pier
cards.subtitle: 600 E. Grand Ave. • Streeterville
cards.notes: Walk the public pier together, pause for lake views and public art, and skip the paid attractions if keeping the outing free.
cards.short_summary: The pier itself is free to enter year-round.
cards.evidence_claim: Navy Pier states that it is free and open to the public year-round.
cards.access_notes: Check seasonal operating hours before traveling. Individual attractions and events can charge admission.

cards.title: Study images at the Museum of Contemporary Photography
cards.subtitle: 600 S. Michigan Ave. • South Loop
cards.notes: Browse the galleries at your own pace, then compare one photograph each that you want to revisit or talk about.
cards.short_summary: Columbia College Chicago’s photography museum is free for all.
cards.evidence_claim: Columbia College Chicago identifies the Museum of Contemporary Photography as free for all.
cards.source_title: Things to Do Near Campus | Columbia College Chicago
cards.access_notes: The source lists MoCP at 600 S. Michigan Ave. Confirm current gallery hours on the museum’s site before visiting.

cards.title: Visit The Renaissance Society galleries
cards.subtitle: 5811 S. Ellis Ave., Cobb Hall 4th Floor • Hyde Park
cards.notes: Take the elevator to the fourth-floor gallery, see the current exhibition, and check whether a free artist talk fits your day.
cards.short_summary: A University of Chicago contemporary-art venue open to the public.
cards.evidence_claim: The Renaissance Society states that all exhibitions and programs are free to attend and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours are Wednesday–Friday noon–6 p.m. and Saturday–Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; it closes between exhibitions.

cards.title: Explore Hyde Park Art Center
cards.subtitle: 5020 S. Cornell Ave. • Hyde Park
cards.notes: Walk through the galleries, look for work by resident artists, and check the events page for an open public program.
cards.short_summary: A community art center with free public gallery access.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyde Park Art Center states that it is free and open to the public seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Hyde Park Art Center
cards.access_notes: The center lists daily hours, with varying closing times; check its events page for holiday closings or special-event changes.

cards.entity_name: National Museum of Puerto Rican Arts & Culture
cards.title: Visit the National Museum of Puerto Rican Arts & Culture
cards.subtitle: Humboldt Park Receptory and Stables • Humboldt Park
cards.notes: Explore the galleries in the historic Receptory and Stables, then pair the visit with a walk through Humboldt Park.
cards.short_summary: A community museum that does not charge admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Museum of Puerto Rican Arts & Culture states that admission is free and that it does not charge admission.
cards.source_title: Visit Us | National Museum of Puerto Rican Arts and Culture
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Tuesday–Thursday 10 a.m.–4:30 p.m., Friday 10 a.m.–3:30 p.m., and Saturday 10 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

cards.title: Use your UIC i-card at the Art Institute
cards.subtitle: 111 S. Michigan Ave. • Loop
cards.notes: Bring a valid UIC student ID to the ticket counter, then choose a few galleries and compare one work each before heading out.
cards.short_summary: UIC students qualify for free general and special-exhibition admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The Art Institute’s University Partner Program lists University of Illinois Chicago and provides free admission for students with valid university ID.
cards.source_title: University Partners | The Art Institute of Chicago
cards.access_notes: Available to UIC students with a valid university ID; present it at the ticket counter and verify current museum hours before visiting.
